text: [210] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṃ okkamato 3 katame pañca dukkhaṃ supati dukkhaṃ paṭibujjhati pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati devatā na rakkhanti asuci muccati ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṃ okkamato . pañcime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā upaṭṭhitassatissa sampajānassa niddaṃ okkamato katame pañca sukhaṃ supati sukhaṃ paṭibujjhati na pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati devatā rakkhanti asuci na muccati ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā upaṭṭhitassatissa sampajānassa niddaṃ okkamatoti . kimbilavaggo paṭhamo . #1 po. ma. yu. attanāpi . 2 ma. evameva kho . 3 po. ma. yu. okkamayato . #aparaṃpi īdisameva . tassuddānaṃ . kimbilo dhammassavanaṃ ājānī 1 ca balaṃ khilaṃ vinibandhaṃ yāgu kaṭṭhaṃ gītaṃ muṭṭhassatīpi 2 cāti . _______________ akkosakavaggo dutiyo
